text_block_list.text: Training with Smart Falcon...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Eeeek...! My legs are completely soaked...!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Because of the rain that was falling just now,
the track conditions are the absolute worst~!
choice_data_list: Shall we wrap it up around here?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, maybe I should.
Even though I really want to keep going...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"As a cute Umadol,
getting this muddy is a bit too much—"

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ...Phew.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"It's getting chilly...
Maybe I should take a moment to stretch."

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Ah, look, Trainer!
Looks like Oguri-senpai is training too!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Falco and Oguri-senpai...
As fellow umadols, we have to greet each other☆
choice_data_list: Is Oguri Cap an Umadol too?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Of cooourse!
After all, Oguri-senpai is—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
She was insanely popular
among everyone back in her hometown of Kasamatsu!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"From Falco's point of view,
you're a 'super-famous regional umadol'!"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for the hard work, Oguri-senpaiâ
Looks like we're both totally covered in mud~

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Mmh... Falco, is it?
Now that you mention it, that's certainly true.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"Falco was thinking of wrapping up soon.
Are you still going to keep practicing, Oguri-senpai?"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Doesn't it bother you,
training while completely covered in mud?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: No, not particularly.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Is it because... everyone back home
cheered for me, no matter how filthy I got?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Right... I should be heading back now. See you later.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
...Kuuugh!
Falco didn't do her homework...!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure that earnest, devoted attitude
is what makes Oguri-senpai such a true Umadol!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: All riiiight! Falco's got an Umadol spirit that won't lose to anyone either!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I need to train with Oguri-senpai
and get closer to becoming a top Umadol!
choice_data_list: Give it your all and do your best!
Give it your all and do your best!
Maybe I'll ask her to do some side-by-side training

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I need to train with Oguri-senpai
and get closer to becoming a top Umadol!
choice_data_list: Give it your all and do your best!
Give it your all and do your best!
Maybe I'll ask her to do some side-by-side training

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Thanks, Trainer-san☆
Well then... I'm off!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: —Oguri-senpai! Falco's decided to keep training after all!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Falco...
I see.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Alright... let's both push ourselves
until we're ready to collapse at the end.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Yes!
That's just what I was hoping for!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, thank you.
That gives me even more to look forward to.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: "If I can expend that much energy, my meals will taste even more delicious."

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
...Huh?
Oguri-senpai, could it be...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"Training without caring about getting dirty...
was that the reason why???"

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Ah, that's right.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: —*Faceplant*—!!!
(SPLAAAATTT!!!)

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Mmh, Falco!?
It's too early to collapse...!

Afterward... by continuing to run with Oguri Cap,
Smart Falcon's stamina and guts
improved significantly!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Yep, that's the plan!
Well then... I'm off!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: —Oguri-senpai! Falco would love to do some tandem training with you!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Falco...
All right, I understand.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
You'll be Front Runner, and I'll be Late Charger.
Let's stay mindful of each other during the race.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Yes!
That's just what I was hoping for!
And after training was over...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Mmh... Falco.
You have mud splattered all over your cheek.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: —Eeehhhhh!?!?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"N-No, no, nooooo!!
I might be able to put up with the tracksuits, but—"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
As an umadol, anything but the face!!
Trainer! Hand me a towel, quick~~!!

...Regardless, training alongside Oguri Cap
greatly refined Smart Falcon's instincts for front-running!
